title: Oversized Clothes
paragraphs: “Filo, let’s see if what Motoyasu said is true. Try transforming into that so-called angel form.”
“Huh? Okay—”

With that, Filo-chan… oh, she’s transforming into a divine and magnificent angel! Golden hair as if beloved by the gods. Eyes as blue as the sky or the sea… a blue so deep even jewels pale in comparison. Pure and snow-white wings on her back. The greatest treasure of this world has finally descended.
Woooooo!
Father is watching this scene with a blank expression. Eventually, he gave Filo-tan a thorough once-over from head to toe.
“Y-you’re completely naked… I suppose so. You aren’t wearing any clothes, after all.”
“I’ll definitely get some clothes ready!”
“No way! I feel like the guy with the spear is staring at me!”

Oh? Filo-chan’s lines are a bit different this time. Filo-chan immediately reverted to her Filolial form. It seems this version of Filo-chan is a bit shy. She’s truly adorable. Father is running his fingers through his hair, glancing back and forth between me… or rather, my “tree,” and Filo-tan.
“Well, I suppose things have turned out just as Motoyasu said they would.”
“So it’s all right to hatch Lady Filolial now, then?”
“That’s a separate matter. Besides, that’s not the only problem.”
“I feel like I’m gradually starting to see what the Spear Hero’s priorities are.”
“Do I really have to lead a guy like this and survive in this world…?”
Father lets out a deep sigh.
“Is something troubling you? Let me, Motoyasu, cut right to the chase and solve it for you.”
“You! You!”
“HAHAHA! You must be joking. This Motoyasu is a man who understands things well.”
“You certainly don’t seem like it, though…”

My older sister is muttering something under her breath, but that’s a misunderstanding! The time will come when she’ll understand. Now is the time to give it our all! That said, thanks to Filo-tan and my Older Sister, it looks like Father is leveling up smoothly. I’d say things are going quite well!
“Well, the hunting went pretty well. You’ve got a pattern for Filo’s clothes… right?”
“Of course I do!”
“Master, what are you doing?”
“Making clothes!”
Saying things like that, Father and the others wrapped up their hunting and returned to Zeltoble.

Then I guided them to the room where I’d set up the equipment that turns Magical Power into thread. On the way back, a foolish bandit—who must’ve thought Filo-tan was a rare catch—attacked us, but I wiped him out immediately. Unfortunately, he wasn’t carrying anything of value.
“So this is the equipment that turns Magical Power into thread?”

Father muttered as he looked at the equipment I’d prepared. Yes, this is indeed the very best equipment for making clothes for Filo-chan and the Filolials. I wanted to buy the very best, so I had quite a hard time coming up with the money. Well, it’s what you’d call a necessary expense. After all, this will allow Filo-chan to shine even more brilliantly.
“That’s right.”
“…Wait a minute. This equipment looks like it’d cost a fortune—did you rent it or something?”
“HAHAHA! Since I’m raising Lord Filolial and the others, of course I bought it!”
“Where on earth did you get that kind of money?!”
“I suppose you wouldn’t think you could buy it for just 20 silver coins, would you? There are so many eggs, after all…”
“Of course I earned the money to buy them! Here’s your change!”
I’ll hand over my entire fortune to Father. Admittedly, it’s not much left after buying Filolial’s eggs and the equipment.
“Oh, come on—it’s actually more than what I gave you… This defeats the whole purpose of an allowance!”
Father is exclaiming in surprise at how capable I am. It makes me feel very proud. I’m going to keep raising my standing at this rate.
“…I should stop worrying about it and just move on with this.”
“What are you going to do?”
“Filo, with this, we’ll turn your Magical Power into thread to make clothes. That way, you won’t end up completely naked when you take human form.”
My beloved Filo-chan is sniffing around the equipment I’ve prepared. What an adorable thing to do.
“Eww, it smells like the Spear Guy! I don’t want to touch it, Filo!”
“Don’t be so selfish! Nothing beats a free gift!”
“Nooo! Master—I want something else! I don’t want to touch this!”
“I can sort of understand how you feel… but Filo, given the nature of this item, could you please bear with it?”
“That’s right, Filo! Otherwise, you’ll end up sharing a room with Motoyasu.”
Oh? Is that a reward? Filo-chan is stealing glances my way. She responds with a beaming smile and a thumbs-up. You’re more than welcome!
“Yaa!”
Filo-tan touches the equipment and starts spinning it around at high speed. Wow, that’s impressive. The equipment is whirring and spinning at high speed. Sparks are even flying!
“…Isn’t this just the right punishment to teach Filo a lesson?”
“What can you do? It’s a good opportunity to teach her that throwing a tantrum won’t lead to anything good.”
“Grrr!”
Filo-chan is spinning the machine like crazy. Is she going to be okay?
“So, Motoyasu. How much thread do we need?”
“We’ll need a fair amount to make clothes. We’ll need a little more.”
“Master, Filo, I want a coat so big that even in my Filolial form, my wings won’t show!”
“I don’t need to ask, but I’ll ask anyway. Why is that?”
“Because the guy with the spear gives me weird looks!”
Weird looks? That’s impossible. After all, I always look at Filo-tan with warm eyes full of respect and affection.
“Ah… right. Well then, maybe I’ll make a cloak in addition to the clothes… though maybe just a cloak from the start would be fine…?”
“Naofumi-sama, even if the cloak just flutters in the Wind, people will still be able to see your body, you know?”
“Hmm…”
“Then I’ll sew a stylish cloak for you!”
Filo-tan immediately stopped operating the machine and turned to look at us.
“…Is the Spear Guy going to make Filo’s clothes?”
Of course. I’ll put together the absolute best outfit for Filo-tan. Oh? Father responded immediately.
“Don’t worry about it.”
“No way! I don’t want to wear anything made by the guy with the spear!”
Filo-tan threw a tantrum. Hmm… she’s so cute.
“I wonder how Motoyasu would feel about being treated like a germ…”

Germs? Filo-tan doesn’t get germs! I used to attend Filo-tan’s autograph sessions quite often in the world after peace was restored. By the way, when it was my turn, Filo-tan would often go take a break. On those occasions, Father would say, “You bought Filo’s break time for her. That’s great, isn’t it?”
It’s an honor to be of service to Filo-tan! Plus, after the handshake events, Father would even give me one of Filo-tan’s feathers as a special gift, so I had absolutely no complaints.

“Ugh, fine… I get it. I’ll go to a Tailor later and place an order, so just hold on! Seriously, it looks like one unnecessary expense after another is coming my way. It would’ve been cheaper with Raphtalia.”
“Please don’t make it sound like I’m the cheap option…”
“Father, won’t you let me make Filo-tan’s outfit?”
“That’s right.”
“That’s a shame! I’d really love to make it myself.”

Well, even Filo-chan from the first world was so shy that she’d refuse whenever I tried to make her clothes. It’s a fond memory of when I secretly donated a stage costume I designed and had her wear it.
“Hold back.”
“Understood. I, Motoyasu, will hold back.”
“He backed down surprisingly easily…”
“It’s kind of scary—it feels like there’s an ulterior motive, doesn’t it?”

Father and the others stared intently at me for a while. The outfits I prefer for Filo-chan aren’t bad, but I love every single thing about her. I’m really looking forward to seeing what kind of look she’ll show us this time.
“Ugh…!? I’ve got goosebumps on my back!”

After that, Filo-chan kept operating the machine that turns Magical Power into thread for a while. While Big Sister kept watch, Father went around to the tailoring shops in Zeltoble and worked out the details. All that’s left is to go to a shop that turns thread into fabric and have them make it properly—then it’ll be complete. To do that, we’ll need to have the tailors take Filo-tan’s measurements. Well, in Zeltoble—a melting pot of races—that sort of thing can be arranged however you like as long as you’re willing to pay.

I was told to stay behind and wait at the inn, but according to Father and the others, it seems things are going well. While they were out, I had them stop by a recommended armory and get a replica of my weapon made. Father-in-law’s shield looks different, doesn’t it? That’s a meteorite shield.
“Well… the sun’s starting to set. Based on what Motoyasu told us, we need to find this ‘Raphtalia’s older sister’.”
“You mean Sadeena, right? Is she really in Zeltoble?”
“Considering everything that’s happened so far, the odds are high… Motoyasu, you know how to find her, don’t you?”
“Of course. If my memory serves me right, if you go on a bar crawl through Zeltoble and recruit anyone you hit it off with, you’re sure to find her Older Sister.”
It’s a foolproof method based on my previous loop experiences. He’ll almost certainly find our Older Sister.
“That’s such a vague…”
“From what I’ve heard from Raphtalia, wouldn’t a Shachi Therianthrope be an instant match?”
“Her Older Sister does have a Demi-Human form, after all.”
“I don’t remember ever seeing her like that, though…”

Big Sister replied, looking somewhat skeptical. It’s true that it’s rare for Older Sister to take her Demi-Human form. Ever since she started living in Father’s village, she’s almost always been in her Therianthrope form, so I suppose that was the case even before we came to this world.
“I’m not entirely sure, but she wasn’t the type to take her Demi-Human form very often in front of you girls.”
“...Considering the location and social etiquette, I can’t say I don’t understand why.”
“What do you mean by that?”
Big Sister asks Father, who seems to understand.
“If I had to operate within Melromarc as the Shield Hero, and if I could conveniently change my form, I’d change it to stay hidden.”
“So you’re saying this is just hearsay?”

“Yeah. I don’t know what kind of mindset Raphtalia’s older sister has that makes her stay in her Therianthrope form so often, but I suppose it was easier for her to move around if she kept her Demi-Human form hidden. On the flip side, in Zeltoble, staying in her Demi-Human form might actually work to her advantage… or something like that.”
“A dual nature… is that it?”
Her older sister murmured as she looked at Filo-chan. A dual nature… that’s it, isn’t it? It’s the difference between Filolial Queen Mode and Angel Mode. Both are wonderful—truly magnificent forms.
“So, here’s the thing. Looking for Raphtalia’s older sister is fine, but taking Raphtalia and the others to the tavern…”
“Hmm?”
“Um… I’ve never seen Sadeena-nee in her Demi-Human form, and she probably wouldn’t be able to spot me right away now that I’ve grown up, right?”
“Going around like that, grasping at straws, and visiting multiple taverns isn’t good for a child.”
“I’m n-not a child!”

Oh, Father is treating Big Sisters like children. I suppose he had dinner with them at a tavern on Calmira Island, but from his perspective, they certainly were children back then. He probably doesn’t want to take them along.
“That said…”
Father looks over at me.
“If it’s your command, this Motoyasu will serve as Father’s bodyguard.”
“You might end up killing someone in excessive self-defense.”
Oh? Is there something wrong with that? It’s for the sake of future generations to eliminate as many evildoers as possible.
“It might be easier if I could at least bring Raphtalia along, but given the nature of the place… I might end up leaving Motoyasu and Filo all alone.”
“No way!? I’m coming too, Filo!”
Little Philo’s throwing a tantrum. It’s quite endearing.
“It’ll be fine. Raphtalia’s there, isn’t she?”
“Ehh… Big Sis Raphtalia?”
“Filo, may I ask you a few questions about that attitude?”
Oh? Does Filo-chan have some kind of complaint against Big Sister?
“Raphtalia, now that you’re Big Sister, you’d better take good care of Filo.”
“Y-yes…? Why is Lord Naofumi saying things like a father would?”
“Because Father is Father, that’s why!”
“Spear Hero, please be quiet! This is getting complicated!”

I got scolded by my Older Sister. Those words came from my future experience, but I didn’t phrase them very well. To ensure she accepts my relationship with Filo-tan in the future, I’ll make an effort to build a better relationship with my Older Sister.

“Anyway… I’ve gotten pretty strong by now, and since I’m steadily working on my enhancements, I can at least run away if an assassin comes after me. If I cut through a crowded area, they probably won’t be able to chase me.”
“If you command it, I’ll take them down.”
“As for that… well, I’m sure we’ll figure it out. After all, you guys are here.”
With that, Father began preparing to leave. It’s certain now that the Older Sister will join our group.
“Yay! Filo’s coming too!”
“Don’t be so selfish! If you make any more fuss, I’ll really hand you over to Motoyasu.”
“Nooo! Master, don’t leave Filo behindnnnn!”
Filo-chan says this in a voice that sounds like she’s screaming. Could it be that when she was left with the Monster Merchant, Filo-chan was screaming just like this?
“Ugh…”

Father looks as if he’s being torn in two. That’s right. No one can resist such a soul-wrenching cry from little Filo. It can’t be helped. Let’s just give up on Older Sister. Or better yet, let’s all go together.
“N-no way!”
